Quickstart|
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━|
|
Get from zero to a first request in five minutes.|
|
┃ Warning Before you start|
┃ You need an API key. Create one under Settings → Keys.|
|
Install|
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────|
|
npm|
|
  bash                                                                  |
  npm install @acme/sdk                                                 |
                                                                        |
|
pnpm|
|
  bash                                                                  |
  pnpm add @acme/sdk                                                    |
                                                                        |
|
Send a request|
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────|
|
1. Create a client|
|
   Pass the key from the environment, never inline.|
|
2. Call the API|
|
     index.ts · ts                                                      |
     const res = await client.ping();                                   |
                                                                        |
|
  curl · bash                                                           |
  curl https://api.acme.dev/v1/ping -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"     |
                                                                        |
|
  Python · python                                                       |
  client.ping()                                                         |
                                                                        |
|
┃ Tip Faster local runs|
┃ Set ACME_CACHE=1 to reuse responses.|
|
API reference (https://docs.acme.dev/api)|
Every endpoint, with examples.|
|
Press [Ctrl] + [C] to stop. The current value is {props.value}.|
|
▸ Troubleshooting|
  • Check the key has the read scope.|
  • Retry after a 429.|
